offers_products.reason: Revenue comes from renting apartments and hotel rooms, not from selling goods.

offers_services.reason: Operates apartment complexes and a hotel, renting housing and lodging; real estate operators count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Apartment tenants and hotel guests are individuals and households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Commercial building tenants and hotel group or corporate bookings are organizations, though a smaller share.

recurring_revenue.reason: Apartment leases bring recurring rent; hotel guests also return, though stays are short.

cyclical_demand.reason: Housing rent is needed in a downturn, though hotel travel demand is more cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Monthly rents and hotel nights are small, frequent payments.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for use of apartments and hotel rooms, so the properties are the main offering.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are residential tenants and hotel guests, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns 16 apartment complexes, a commercial building and a hotel interest; growth needs property investment.

notes: Hotel interest (Hilton San Francisco Financial District) may be a large part of revenue; hotel answers could be more cyclical.
